page.overview:
What is Progenitor's Call?

The Progenitor's Call was a Force technique used by the adepts of the Order of Shasa. The adept using this power enjoyed a better protection from attacks in combat. This could be achieved by making use of the natural power of the giant Firaxan shark that the Selkath called the Progenitor.

Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
